Ethan Price 104  
Amsterdam, Netherlands | ethan.price@ecomvista.com | +31 6 1234 5678 | linkedin.com/in/ethanprice104  

A seasoned software engineer with a focus on scalable system design and cross-functional collaboration in the e-commerce sector. Over the past three years, I’ve led the development of microservices architectures, streamlined CI/CD pipelines, and bridged technical and business priorities across teams. My work emphasizes sustainable practices, measurable outcomes, and alignment with agile principles.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Tech Lead*  
EcomVista Ltd. | 2022–2023  
Led a team of four engineers to refactor legacy monolithic systems into modular microservices, reducing deployment time by 40% and improving fault isolation. Introduced GitHub Actions to automate testing and deployment, integrating with existing monitoring tools to enable real-time alerting for critical failures. Collaborated with product managers to define technical debt reduction roadmaps, prioritizing features based on user impact and business value.  

*Senior Software Engineer*  
EcomVista Ltd. | 2021–2022  
Architected a scalable order processing pipeline using Kafka for event-driven workflows, increasing system throughput by 35% during peak traffic. Mentored junior engineers on best practices for API design and distributed system patterns, resulting in a 25% reduction in integration-related bugs. Played a key role in transitioning teams from waterfall to agile methodologies, aligning sprint planning with stakeholder feedback loops.  

*Software Engineer*  
RetailNexus Inc. | 2020–2021  
Developed and maintained core components of a recommendation engine, leveraging collaborative filtering algorithms to improve conversion rates by 12%. Automated infrastructure provisioning using shell scripts, reducing manual setup time for new environments. Participated in cross-functional workshops to align technical solutions with customer journey maps, ensuring features addressed pain points in the checkout process.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
*Microservices Architecture for EcomVista*  
Designed and implemented a multi-tenant microservices framework using Spring Boot and Docker, enabling independent scaling of inventory, payment, and user management modules. Integrated with Prometheus for metrics collection and Grafana for dashboards, providing actionable insights into system performance.  

*CI/CD Optimization at RetailNexus*  
Refactored existing Jenkins pipelines to use GitHub Actions, reducing build times by 20% and improving visibility into deployment stages. Introduced canary release strategies, minimizing risk during feature rollouts while maintaining high availability.  

*Stakeholder Communication Tool*  
Developed a lightweight dashboard for non-technical stakeholders, visualizing system health and incident resolution times. Built using React and Python, it reduced manual reporting efforts and improved transparency across teams.

Master of Science in Computer Science | Stanford University | 2021
